_comment: The furniture pack's art (content sets GEN-2): SHAPES ONLY, no image file, in the meta theme's recipe format (a 20x20 box, the maze's TILE_PX). Both are drawn OVER the cell the maze has already painted (the tile-kind overlay), so neither fills the whole box: the rug lets the floor show at its fringe, and the pillar is a round column standing on the wall the generator lowered under it. Art is presentation only.
